career_ladder.note: Constables in the Kolkata Police Commissionerate are appointed to maintain law, order, and traffic administration across the Kolkata metropolitan jurisdiction. Service progression is governed by the Kolkata Police Act, Calcutta Suburban Police Act, departmental service regulations, and the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019). Promotion to Assistant Sub-Inspector and Sub-Inspector is conducted through departmental examinations and seniority.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Constables and Lady Constables in Kolkata Police is conducted by the West Bengal Police Recruitment Board (WBPRB). The examination scheme consists of: (i) Preliminary Written Test (PWT, 100 marks) as a qualifying screening stage, (ii) Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET), (iii) Final Written Examination (85 marks), and (iv) Interview (15 marks). Merit ranking for final appointment is determined by the combined score of the Final Written Examination and Interview (Total: 100 marks).

financial_package.note: Constables and Lady Constables in Kolkata Police are remunerated under Pay Level 6 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019), corresponding to pre-revised Pay Band-2 (₹5,400 – ₹25,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,600). Entry basic pay is ₹22,700.
financial_package.pay_source_label: WBPRB Notice & WBS (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019, Level 6
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on ROPA 2019 Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹22,700 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (₹13,166), 12% House Rent Allowance (₹2,724), Medical Allowance (₹500/month), plus statutory metropolitan Kolkata Police allowances including ration subsidy and kit/washing maintenance. Deductions include West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹150–₹200) and GPF/NPS contributions (~10% basic+DA).
official_perks: Kolkata Police residential quarters accommodation or 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Coverage under the West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS) for police personnel and family dependents
Metropolitan police dietary / ration allowance for urban patrolling and active duty personnel
Annual uniform allowance, kit replacement, and monthly washing allowance
Metropolitan compensatory duty allowances during major festivals (Durga Puja), sports events, and VIP security
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment under West Bengal Service Rules
